definition_quote.value: "Apiary" means any place where one or more colonies of honey bees are kept.
definition_quote.quote: "Apiary" means any place where one or more colonies of honey bees are kept.

registration_required.quote: All persons keeping bees in the State or moving bees into the State shall annually register any and all of their colonies and apiary locations with the Department on forms supplied by the Department on or before January 30 of each year.

colony_count_reporting_required.quote: they shall notify the State Apiarist in writing within 10 days of the time the bees are acquired, of the number and location of colonies.

apiary_location_reporting_required.quote: shall annually register any and all of their colonies and apiary locations with the Department

movable_frame_hive_required.quote: All persons keeping bees in this State shall provide movable frames in all hives used by them, and cause the bees in such hives to construct all combs in such frames so that such frames may be removed from the hive without injuring other combs in the hive

import_permit_required.quote: No person shall ship or transport any colony of bees, or used beekeeping equipment into the State that is not accompanied by an entry permit issued by the Department.

import_certificate_of_inspection_require.quote: the person shall request an entry permit by submitting to the Department an inspection certificate from an authorized inspector of the state of origin

import_certificate_validity_days.quote: a statement that the colonies or used beekeeping equipment is apparently free of all diseases, mite infestation, exotic mites and Africanized honey bees, based on an inspection within the preceding 60 days.

africanized_bee_regulated.quote: "Africanized bee" means Apis mellifera scutellata or Apis mellifera adansonii or other exotic species.

value: exotic mite (Tropilaelaps clarae, Varroa jacobsoni, Varroa rindereri, Varroa sinhai, Varroa wongsirii)
regulated_diseases.quote: "Bee diseases" means American or European foul brood or any other infectious or contagious disease pronounced detrimental to beekeeping by the Department of Agriculture or the State Apiarist.

disease_reporting_required.quote: Any person keeping bees in the State shall notify the State Apiarist immediately of the existence or the suspected existence of any bee disease, mite infestation, exotic mite or Africanized honey bee in such person's own or any other apiary in the State.

quarantine_authority.quote: the State Apiarist or the bee inspector, subject to the approval of the Department of Agriculture, shall declare such apiaries to be each the center of a quarantine zone in the form of a circle 3 miles in radius

inspector_disinfection_required_after_in.quote: the State Apiarist or inspector shall take such measures as shall prevent the spread of the disease by infected material adhering to the State Apiarist's or inspector's person or clothing or to any equipment or appliances used by the State Apiarist or inspector which may have come in contact with infected material.

right_of_entry_scope.quote: the Department of Agriculture, the State Apiarist and the state bee inspectors may enter upon any public or private premises, and shall have access, ingress and egress to and from all apiaries or places where bees, bee equipment and appliances are kept

queen_rearing_apiary_certification_requi.quote: Every person rearing queen bees in the State for gift or sale shall have such person's queen-rearing apiaries inspected at least once each year by the State Apiarist or inspector

transfer_permit_required_for_diseased_eq.quote: No person shall sell, barter or give away, accept, receive or transport any bees, equipment or appliances from an apiary known to be affected with a bee disease, mite infestation, exotic mite or Africanized honey bee, without the consent in writing of the State Apiarist
